notes.title: "Glow Ball - Not A Billiard Puzzle Game" Released!
"Glow Ball - Not A Billiard Puzzle Game"
notes.content:
PREQUEL!
Glow Ball wants to shine at the felt of a billiard table. He wants to get a number, and perhaps become a cue ball. He doesn't want to jump all his life on these fkn plates in this game. So help him to become a billiard ball! Fulfill his dream!

Available: 18 May
https://store.steampowered.com/app/856420
